versions.changelog:
Initial release of feishu-knowledge-manager:

- Automatically saves external article content to Feishu Docs and summarizes key points in the knowledge base.
- Supports different link types (WeChat, Xiaohongshu, YouTube, generic webpages) via dedicated tools.
- Organizes knowledge into themed categories for easy reference.
- Includes scheduled daily knowledge-base cleanup, duplicate removal, and optimization at 9:00 AM.
- Provides suggestions for knowledge base structure and cron job setup.
